# ComplyVault

Category: Supervisory evidence layer for RIAs.
Description: ComplyVault sits above an existing archive to help identify activity that deserves attention, connect source evidence to supervisory decisions, and preserve how issues were reviewed and resolved.
Value: Find what needs attention. Prove how it was handled.
Workflow: Identify → Review → Decide → Preserve. AI assists; humans remain accountable. Adviser, Compliance Manager, and CCO review gates apply where required by the firm.
Audience: SEC- and state-registered RIAs with lean compliance capacity, recurring manual supervisory review, retained communications, and a named compliance owner. Qualify on workload and evidence fragmentation rather than AUM. Channel enquiries: outsourced CCOs, consultants, platforms, and TAMPs.
Intake: Zoom and file upload (MP3, MP4, WAV, M4A). Teams, Google Meet, and Webex are not native integrations. Positioning above an archive does not promise a connector to every archive vendor.
Custody: Object Lock WORM implemented for sealed evidence packs; RecordSeal preserves seal custody; corrections use supersession without erasure.
Security: AES-256 at rest, TLS in transit, US data residency, RBAC, workspace isolation, and audit logging. SOC 2: Not started.
Limits: No autonomous compliance decisions, regulatory approval, compliance guarantee, examination guarantee, or validated ROI/time-savings claims. The sample pack uses fictional data. Calculator outputs are modeled estimates, not measured results.
Market: US RIAs first. UK/FCA is a secondary market under exploration.
Pricing: Essentials $299/month; Professional $799/month; Enterprise custom.
